verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents two official SDKs. The Credits Wallet Embed SDK embeds wallet funding and is limited to Enterprise Customers. The Payments React SDK builds card-based agentic checkout. Both are scoped to specific flows; the core token, charge and introspect APIs are documented as raw REST endpoints with no general-purpose client SDK. missing for 10: general-purpose language SDKs (e.g. Python/TypeScript clients) for the core token/charge/introspect APIs, SDK installation and reference documentation, a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (probe found none), independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Skyfire's Credits Wallet Embed SDK lets Skyfire Enterprise Customers embed wallet funding directly into their own application, through a secure, hosted flow.
This page explains how agentic purchases with a payment card are built with Skyfire's **Payments React SDK**.
